svg.title: Index Translator browser components, player and captions
svg.desc: Once a recording is being transcribed, the media module plays it above the transcript from a blob URL, with the audio tracks that were not chosen hidden. The cue at the playhead is marked in the source and its counterpart in the translation. A video with a picture also gets caption tracks, one for the original, one for the translation and one for both, rebuilt as either text changes. A column of Play from buttons starts the player at any cue. captions: public/app.ts → public/media-ui.ts → public/caption-tracks.ts → public/captions.ts.

g.text: the player, cue at the playhead
